title: Shama-Sambuga | Ethnologue Free
text: Shama-Sambuga is a stable indigenous language of Nigeria. It belongs to the Niger-Congo language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.

title: Shama language
text: The Shama language, also known as Shama-Sambuga, is a Kainji language of the Niger-Congo family (ISO 639-3: sqa) spoken primarily by around 10,000 people in the ethnic Shama community of Nigeria.
